items: Drink adequate fluids. Aim 200 ml of fluid every hour (one small cup) while awake. Examples of fluids include fruit juice, oral rehydration salts (ORS), coconut water, or soup.
Take paracetamol for fever or pain when necessary, but not to exceed 4g per day.
Get adequate rest.
Monitor the temperature and dengue warning signs.
Seek immediate medical care if warning signs develop.
Attend daily follow-up appointments as advised.
Look for mosquito breeding places in and around the home and prevent mosquito bites using mosquito repellent.
DO NOT take steroids, aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, or any other NSAIDs. If you are already taking these medications, please consult your doctors.
DO NOT consume traditional or herbal remedies.
DO NOT take intramuscular injections.
DO NOT do massage, cupping or gua sha.

groups.p: As the fever starts to subside, be cautious as the condition may become dangerous and worsen in some dengue patients. Go to the hospital immediately if any of the following occur:
items: General condition worsening or symptoms becoming more severe
Severe abdominal pain
Persistent vomiting
Extreme fatigue
Difficulty breathing or rapid breathing
Fainting spells
Bleeding from the gums or nose, or blood in vomit, urine, or stool
Reduced urine output less than 4 times per day

ms.title: Nasihat pemantauan demam denggi di rumah

items: Minum air secukupnya sebanyak 200 ml setiap jam (satu cawan kecil) sewaktu jaga. Contoh minuman termasuk jus buah, larutan garam rehidrasi (ORS), air kelapa, atau sup.
Ambil paracetamol untuk demam atau sakit badan jika perlu, tetapi tidak melebihi 4g sehari.
Dapatkan rehat yang mencukupi.
Pantau suhu badan dan tanda amaran demam denggi.
Dapatkan rawatan segera jika tanda amaran muncul.
Hadiri temujanji susulan.
Periksa tempat pembiakan nyamuk di rumah serta cegah gigitan nyamuk menggunakan semburan penghalau nyamuk.
JANGAN ambil steroids, aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, atau ubat anti-radang bukan steroid (NSAIDs) lain. Sila rujuk doktor jika anda sedang mengambil ubat-ubatan ini.
JANGAN ambil ubat-ubat tradisional atau herba.
JANGAN ambil suntikan intramuskular.
JANGAN berurut, bekam atau gua sha.

groups.p: Apabila demam mula kebah, anda perlu berhati-hati kerana keadaan boleh menjadi berbahaya dan semakin teruk bagi sesetengah pesakit demam denggi. Segera ke hospital jika anda mempunyai salah satu tanda-tanda berikut:
items: Keadaan badan semakin lemah atau simptom semakin teruk
Sakit perut yang teruk
Muntah berterusan
Keletihan melampau
Susah bernafas atau pernafasan laju
Pitam
Pendarahan pada gusi atau hidung, atau darah dalam muntah, air kencing atau najis
Kekerapan kencing kurang dari 4 kali sehari
